The passes array contains only the pass_id=3 block; the schema keyword passes.contains {pass_id: 1} is a template artifact that cannot be satisfied by a user-narrowed single-pass run and is intentionally unsatisfied (same convention as the prior manual pass-3 runs).

All 156 candidate rows (sources.csv 77 + sinks.csv 79) were dispositioned: 0 rows dropped, 0 merged - every (file, line, callable) candidate is distinct. Signature-level deduplication (e.g. the 28 urljoin call sites resolving to one urljoin summary predicate) is deferred to Step 4 library generation, where it is deterministic.

No sanitizer entries: the codebase contains no scheme/host allowlist, no private-IP blocking and no redirect validation (verified recurly/resource.py:240-250); TLS CA validation, API-key authentication and the socket timeout restrict nothing about the request target.

The target is a client SDK, not a service: there are no routes, handlers or login boundaries. 'source' entries mark the embedding-application boundary (public API parameters) and second-order carriers (server-controlled href/Location/Link values); all carry classification 'candidate' pending host-application context - no vulnerability is claimed by this run.
